categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes peer connection timeout handling in src/net_processing.cpp and bears the P2P area label.
categories.rationale: Prevents valid peers on slow connections from being disconnected when block transfers delay ping responses past the 20-minute timeout. As the description notes, 'peers prioritize block responses over pings, which can cause the ping timeout of 20 minutes to expire and drop peers that are behaving correctly.' This fixes an annoying liveness issue during sync over constrained bandwidth, but is an edge-case bug fix that is reasonably deferrable.
